details.label: Discussion
details.text: A thunderstorm has recently intensified over Pike County, IL, on the southern flank of a long-lived convective system. Latest objective analysis suggests that a narrow corridor of moderate instability (MLCAPE of 1500-2000 J/kg) has developed immediately ahead of the storm. However, earlier storms in the St. Louis vicinity have at least temporarily stabilized the air mass from east-central MO into southwest IL, which may limit a longer-duration severe weather threat with the above-mentioned storm. As such, a watch is not currently expected. However, KLSX does show some base velocity enhancement, suggesting the potential for locally damaging wind gusts in the near term
